description_en: Queries the details of an egress proxy configuration
description_zh: 查询出口配置详细信息
name: GetEgressProxyConfigurationAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy configuration
parameters.name: egress_proxy_configuration_id

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the egress proxy configuration. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 出口配置的创建时间。采用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DefaultRulePhaseActions.description_en: The default actions executed in each effective phase (PreDns, PreRequest, and PostResponse) when traffic does not match any rules
DefaultRulePhaseActions.description_zh: 各生效阶段（PreDns、PreRequest、PostResponse）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作

PostResponse.description_en: The default action executed in the PostResponse phase (after a response is returned) when traffic does not match any rules. This phase only supports the value Allow (default), which indicates that the traffic is allowed
PostResponse.description_zh: PostResponse 阶段（响应返回后）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作。该阶段仅支持取值 Allow（默认值），即允许通过

PreDns.description_en:
The default action executed in the PreDns phase (before DNS resolution) when traffic does not match any rules. Valid values:

Allow (default): allows the traffic.

Deny: denies the traffic
PreDns.description_zh:
PreDns 阶段（DNS 解析前）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作。取值：

Allow（默认值）：允许通过。

Deny：拒绝

PreRequest.description_en:
The default action executed in the PreRequest phase (before a request is forwarded) when traffic does not match any rules. Valid values:

Allow (default): allows the traffic.

Deny: denies the traffic
PreRequest.description_zh:
PreRequest 阶段（请求转发前）在流量未命中任何规则时执行的默认动作。取值：

Allow（默认值）：允许通过。

Deny：拒绝

Description.description_en: The description of the egress proxy configuration. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
Description.description_zh: 出口配置的描述信息。长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）

EgressProxyConfigurationId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy configuration

EgressProxyConfigurationName.description_en: The name of the egress proxy configuration. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
EgressProxyConfigurationName.description_zh: 出口配置的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

RuleGroups.description_en: The list of egress rule group references associated with the egress proxy configuration
RuleGroups.description_zh: 出口配置关联的出口规则组引用列表

EgressProxyRuleGroupId.description_en: The ID of the egress rule group

Priority.description_en: The priority of the egress rule group in the egress proxy configuration. Valid values: 1 to 1000. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 出口规则组在该出口配置中的优先级。取值范围：1~1000，取值越小优先级越高

Status.description_en:
The status of the egress proxy configuration. Valid values:

Provisioning: The configuration is being created.

Available: The configuration is available.

Configuring: The configuration is being modified
Status.description_zh:
出口配置的状态。取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Available：可用。

Configuring：变配中

Key.description_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

Value.description_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
